name: Modern Geometric Kun Faya Kun Acrylic Art
short_desc: Modernize your sacred decor with this high-contrast geometric acrylic painting of Kun Faya Kun ("Be, and it is"). Sealed with a protective gloss varnish, its sharp black, white, and gray color blocks fit sleek minimalist entryways and modern apartments.
seo_title: Modern Geometric Kun Faya Kun Acrylic Art – Black, White & Gray Minimalist Islamic Calligraphy
description:
Bring sharp architectural precision and spiritual depth together with this modern geometric Islamic artwork. The piece centers on the divine command Kun Faya Kun ("Be, and it is"), rendered in sweeping, high-contrast white Arabic script.

Painted with premium acrylic paints, the design features angular color-blocking in deep black, crisp white, and cool neutral gray. The clean diagonal lines create a dynamic, modern backdrop that amplifies the fluidity of the calligraphic script.

A high-grade gloss varnish seal coats the artwork, guarding against dust, UV fading, and scratches while giving the solid color blocks a smooth, premium finish under lighting.

Encased in a slim black frame, this piece is tailored for modern apartments, sleek entryways, minimalist living rooms, or contemporary corporate spaces.

Key Specifications & Features:

Medium & Materials: Premium heavy-body acrylic paints

Surface Coating: Protective gloss varnish coat for color protection and clean finish

Theme & Script: Kun Faya Kun (Quran 36:82) in modern calligraphic composition

Color Palette: High-contrast black, white, and gray geometric color-blocks

Style: Minimalist Geometric / Modern Islamic Art Fusion

Ideal Placement: Urban entryway, modern living room, office lobby, or minimalist hallway
